The label is legible and shows model 9421, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The purchase is from a listed retailer (Controlled Access of the Midwest) dated 2024-02-16, inside the sale window; no receipt is required for this claim.

The serial on the label (SN72780317) does not match the typed serial (SN30627223). The serial check was skipped, so this discrepancy has not been verified against the recalled ranges and needs review along with the flag.
